capabilities: store person names and birthdays in a Markdown file
show a notice for people whose birthday is today
display an overview sorted by next birthday
browse birthdays in a year view
configure the data file location and date format
extras: Birthdays must be entered line by line in a fixed name=...; birthday=... format, and the data file must be a .md file set in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to store personal birthdays and get notified of who has a birthday today.
summary: Birthday tracker that reads person entries from a note, notifies you of birthdays today, and shows upcoming and yearly overviews.
